column3: Close to the Hebrew; “Teacher” (Qoheleth) is rendered “the Preacher.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Futility” (hevel) is rendered “Vanity,” and NASB punctuates the words as the Preacher’s speech.
Close to the Hebrew; “Profit” is rendered “advantage,” and “toil” as “work.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Panting” is rendered “hastening.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Anyone” is rendered “Man.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Heart” is rendered “mind,” “a task of evil” as “a grievous task,” and “to be busy with” as “to be afflicted with.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Futility” is rendered “vanity,” and “striving of wind” as “striving after wind.”
Close to the Hebrew; “I spoke with my heart” is rendered “I said to myself,” and “my heart has seen” as “my mind has observed.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Heart” is rendered “mind,” and “I knew” as “I realized.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Frustration” is rendered “grief.”
